projectDescription: A full-featured CRM platform for social services agencies to manage client cases, program enrollments, appointments, and the ACA insurance pipeline.
keyFeatures: Client profile management with program enrollments (Medicaid, SNAP, TCA, ACA)
Live queue management with walk-in and appointment check-in
ACA insurance pipeline tracking with contact history and enrollment stats
Case management across multiple programs and renewal cycles
Task management with priority levels and due dates
Custom report builder across clients, pipeline, and queue data
Role-based access control (Owner, Admin, Manager, Case Manager, Front Desk)
Multi-office support with office-scoped data views
Document storage with signed URL access and archiving
Audit logging for all data changes
publicApiSurface: Dashboard: stat cards (total clients, current queue, ACA pipeline, renewals due, open tasks)
Clients: list, create, edit, view profile with program tabs
Cases: list by office, create case, add enrollment cycle, update status
Queue: live queue board with check-in, call-next, assign, complete actions
Appointments: schedule, check-in via queue, edit, cancel
ACA Pipeline: track leads through Eligible → Pending Password → Ready to Enroll → Enrolled
Tasks: create, assign, set priority (urgent/high/normal/low), track status
Invoices: create, assign to staff, generate PDF, track payment status
Reports: pre-built and custom report builder with CSV export
Settings: user profile, MFA enrollment, staff invite/archive/reset, office management
